title: Pocketwire Pay in 4 Spending Power and Plan Limits Schedule
content:
## Rule

On a Pocketwire Pay in 4 account, a new plan is created only within three limits:

1. **Spending power.** The unpaid purchase amounts of all open plans, together with the new purchase, may not exceed the account's effective spending power. The effective spending power is the tier's spending power increased by the tier's plan bonus while the linked Pocketwire Personal Account is on Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, and the tier's spending power alone while it is on any other plan.
2. **Open plans.** At most the tier's maximum number of open plans are open at the same time.
3. **Plans per day.** At most the tier's daily plan limit are created on one calendar day.

Spending power frees up as installments are paid on tiers where spending power is restored on each payment, and only when a plan is fully paid on the other tiers.

## Schedule

The figures apply to an account according to the Pocketwire Pay in 4 tier it is on.

| Tier | Spending power (USD) | Plan bonus with Prime, Onyx or Summit (USD) | Effective spending power with the bonus (USD) | Maximum open plans | Plans created per calendar day | Spending power restored on each installment paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 250.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 2 | 1 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 500.00 | 100.00 | 600.00 | 3 | 2 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 1000.00 | 100.00 | 1100.00 | 5 | 2 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 1500.00 | 250.00 | 1750.00 | 6 | 3 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 2000.00 | 250.00 | 2250.00 | 8 | 3 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 3000.00 | 500.00 | 3500.00 | 10 | 5 | Yes |

## How the counts are taken

- **Open plans** are the account's plans not yet fully paid, refunded or written off, taken as they stand on the day of handling.
- **The unpaid purchase amounts** are, for each open plan, the part of its purchase amount that still occupies spending power: on a tier where spending power is restored on each installment paid, the part of its purchase amount still unpaid, which falls as each installment is paid; on the other tiers, the whole purchase amount until the plan is fully paid.
- **Plans created on one calendar day** are the account's plans whose purchase date is the day of handling, the calendar day being taken in Eastern Time.

## Worked example (hypothetical purchases)

An account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic whose linked personal account is on Pocketwire Prime has an effective spending power of USD 600.00. It has one open plan for a purchase of USD 200.00, of which USD 50.00 has been paid.

- Classic does not restore spending power on each installment, so the open plan still occupies USD 200.00, and the room left is USD 400.00.
- A new purchase of USD 400.00 brings the total to exactly USD 600.00, which does not exceed the effective spending power, so the spending power limit is met.
- A new purchase of USD 400.01 would bring the total to USD 600.01, which exceeds it, so no plan is created for it.

Had the same account been on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select with spending power USD 1000.00 and the same bonus of USD 100.00, the open plan would occupy only its unpaid USD 150.00.

## Points of judgement

- The effective spending power follows only from the tier and the plan of the linked personal account while the new purchase is made: on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter the bonus is USD 0.00 whatever that plan is.
- An account that already has its tier's maximum number of open plans cannot open another plan while that number stays open, even with spending power left.
- An account that has already created its tier's daily number of plans cannot create another plan on the same calendar day.
